description: 8-channel relay output with pulse output and delay modes. Relay state via FC01 coil addr 16-23 (R/W). FC03 addr 302: packed relay state word. FC03 addr 0-103: pulse output timing config. Modbus enabled when FF parameter bit2=1.
source: Omni Console device library (OmniCoreST), modbus-library/advantech-adam-4168-relay.toml; Source: advantech-adam-4100-modbus.pdf (Appendix B, B.4). Not verified against the manufacturer's documentation

| - 8-channel relay output with pulse output and delay timing capabilities.
| - Modbus RTU enabled when FF parameter bit 2 = 1; default is ADAM ASCII protocol.
| - FC01 addr 16-23 (00017-00024): Relay Output Value ch 0-7 (R/W).
| - FC01 addr 32-39 (00033-00040): Pulse output mode Continue(1)/Non-Continue(0) ch 0-7 (R).
| - FC03 addr 0-15: Pulse output L level time ch 0-7 (u32, unit 0.1ms, 2 regs each) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 16-31: Pulse output H level time ch 0-7 (u32, unit 0.1ms) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 32-47: Set absolute pulse count ch 0-7 (u32; 0=continuous mode) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 48-63: Set incremental pulse count ch 0-7 (u32) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 72-87: DO low delay width ch 0-7 (u32) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 88-103: DO high delay width ch 0-7 (u32) (R/W).
